main_text.p: ligi debeat Concilii Tridentini decretum, quod non assequi videbatur Cardinalis Barberinus, fusius prosequitur hoc loco Morinus, ex sententia doctissimorum Ecclesiæ Romanæ Theologorum: ac demum his omnibus subjungit, ut Barberino in omnibus satisfaciat, optâsse quidem Capellum, novam fieri veteris testamenti versionem ex Hebraeo contextu, in cujus margine variæ lectiones undiq; selectæ collocarentur, sed hoc non præjudicare Concilii decreto, quod tantum vult, Latinam editionem cæteris translationibus præferri, at novam ex Hebraeo aut Græco Interpretatione ad originarii textus Illustrationem condi, nunquam prohibuit. Hactenus Morinus; qui in omnibus se ostendit Criticæ Sacræ Ludovici Capelli strenuissimum defensorem; dignaque est profecto hæc Epistola, quæ in lucem edatur, ut Theologi præsertim Parisienses, quorum pleriqve vulgarem editionem adorant, eosque ferre non possunt, qui de nova ad contextum Hebræum aut Græcum translatione paranda cogi-

page.notes: Printed text runs as the printer set it; the word "Ludovici" and "Capelli" are as printed. Several words are slightly blurred in the scan, notably "optâsse" (printed "optâsse" with circumflex, read as "optâsse"; may be "optasse"), "variæ", "pleriqve" and "Concilii". "Criticæ Sacræ" is printed with a space and a cramped ligature; "Sacræ" may read "Sacræ". The first word "ligi" begins a fragment of a word from the previous page ("obligi" or "ligi") and is kept as a fragment. Some words run together in the printing (e.g. "debeatConcilii", "Hebræo"); printed spacing errors are left as they are. The word "optâsse" is uncertain and marked below.
